items.title: Each full re-render adds about 220 MB of draft video to the repository
items.note: Curt chose GitHub Release files. Chapter drafts now go to the repo's drafts release (publish_review.mjs uploads them under content-hashed names), and the pages play them from there with a source element typed video/mp4, which Safari needs because GitHub serves release files as octet-stream. Checked in Chromium and Safari: a draft page, and the annotated film jumping to chapter 7. The old videos stay in git history (about 530 MB); removing them would mean rewriting history and a force push.

items.title: Chapter 5: Roal's turn to go squashes him to a sliver for two frames
items.note: At 6:29 (p064, as F-2 finishes) Roal turns to walk away by squashing his profile through 20% of its width, so two frames show him as a vertical line. Now never thinner than 60%: rendered at 388.75-389.17 s, he narrows and flips. Re-rendering chapter 5.

items.title: Chapter 1: two worker machines fly stacked for 12 s, like one drawn twice
items.note: Workers 7 and 8 had near-equal speeds, heights 18 px apart and near-equal random starts, so from about 0:57 to 1:09 they flew one over the other. Now each has its own lane (25 px apart) and starts a ninth of the loop from the next, searched so no two in near lanes overlap more than 3 s. Rendered at 50-140 s. Re-rendering chapter 1.

items.title: Chapter 2: the Outsiders searching ship 2 walk through each other
items.note: The three searchers swayed ±140 px round spots 160 apart, so at 4:12-4:15 two stood almost wholly over each other, and at 4:36 the one with the projector landed on the middle one. Now they sway ±25 round 2290, 2500 and 2990, leaving a gap at 2750 for the projector. Rendered at 243-290 s. Re-rendering chapter 2.

items.title: Chapter 3: a machine stands at Trest's back through Roal's speech; Jupiter and Saturn overlap
items.note: The ring was centred at 1000, so one of its far half stood at 1192, just behind Trest (1160), from 6:12 to 7:04. Centred between them (1060) now, every far machine is 90 px or more from both and no near one is in front. In the worlds (U), evenly spaced planets let Jupiter and Saturn overlap and show through each other; they're spaced by size now, 90 apart edge to edge. Rendered at 372-420 and 430-468 s. Re-rendering chapter 3.

items.title: Chapter 6: the Outsiders feeding the generators stand in overlapped pairs
items.note: Inside the giant ship (F, 1:52-2:08) the four stood at 460, 600, 1460 and 1620, less than a body's width apart, so each pair read as one figure drawn twice. Now at 320, 570, 1370 and 1620. Rendered at 118 and 126 s. Re-rendering chapter 6.

items.title: Chapter 7: the dome starts as a stray triangle
items.note: On 'it arched over them' (2:42) the canopy swept round from the left as a slice pinned to the floor at the centre, so for its first seconds it drew a thin black wedge with a wavy edge, then a lopsided blob. Now the whole arch spreads across and rises from a low canopy to the dome. Rendered at 162.5-167 s. Re-rendering chapter 7.

items.title: The Outsiders' ships are see-through: a ship behind shows through one in front
items.note: In chapter 10 (2:18) the flagship's ribs showed through an escort crossing it, and the dense fleets of chapters 2, 3 and 6 show the same. The hull now has a solid base under its washes (designs.js: solidFill, as the Outsiders got). Rendered in chapters 10 (138 s), 6 (64, 80 s) and 2 (36, 60 s). Shared, so all twelve drafts re-render.
